pair.title: Use Kettu in this browser
pair.intro: In Kettu on the computer, or on a device already added to it, open Settings › Remote access › Add device, choose Browser and scan its QR code with this device's camera, or paste its link here.
pair.introHosted: On the computer, open Kettu’s Settings › Remote access › Add device and scan its QR code with this device’s camera, or paste its link here. The computer must be signed in to the same Kettu account with the Kettu relay on.
pair.notLink: This is not a Kettu pairing link. Copy the link from Add device.
pair.waiting: Confirm where the code is shown
pair.waitingHint: Kettu asks there whether to add “{{name}}”. Choose Add.

failed.void: This code no longer works: it expired, was closed or was used for another device. Open Add device again for a new one.
failed.rejected: The computer’s owner did not add this browser.
failed.unreachable: Could not reach the computer. Check that it is on, Kettu is running with remote access on, and this device is on the same network or VPN.
failed.update_client: This page is older than Kettu on the computer. Reload the page.
failed.update_host: Kettu on the computer is too old for this page. Update Kettu on the computer.
failed.failed: Pairing did not finish. Try again.
failed.relay_off: This code is for the computer’s own network: it is not using the Kettu relay. Turn on Use the Kettu relay in its Settings › Remote access, or open the browser link from Add device on the same network.
failed.wrong_account: The computer is signed in to another Kettu account. Sign in here with the account the computer uses.
failed.host_offline: The computer is not on the Kettu relay now. Check that it is on, Kettu is running with remote access on, and it is signed in to your Kettu account.

pair.removed: This browser was removed from the computer. Pair it again to use it here.

insecure.title: This page is not protected on the network
insecure.body: Your conversation stays encrypted, but someone on this network could change the page itself. On a network you do not trust, use an SSH tunnel or HTTPS, such as Tailscale’s. Notifications need one of those too.

connection.updated: Kettu on the computer was updated.

project.title: Open project
project.description: Type the path of a folder on {{host}}.

agentFolder.title: Choose agent folder
agentFolder.description: Type the path of the agent's configuration folder on {{host}}.

shell.title: Choose shell
shell.description: Type the path of the shell program on {{host}}.

agentProgram.title: Choose agent program
agentProgram.description: Type the path of the agent's program on {{host}}.

worktreeRoot.title: Choose worktree location
worktreeRoot.description: Type the path of the folder on {{host}} where new worktrees go.

path.label: Path on {{host}}
path.start: Type a full path, or start with ~ for your home folder.
path.keys: Tab completes a name; ↑ and ↓ move through the list, and Enter takes the one picked.
path.notFolder: This is a file. Choose a folder.
path.folderNotProgram: This is a folder. Choose a program in it.
path.empty: Nothing to choose in this folder.
path.missing: There is no such folder on {{host}}.

notifications.testBody: Notifications are on. This is how an agent that needs you will reach you while this page is open.
notifications.openOnly: Notifications need this page open in the browser, even in a background tab; a closed page gets none.
notifications.insecure: Browsers give notifications only to pages on https or localhost. Open this page through an SSH tunnel to localhost, or over HTTPS such as Tailscale's, to get them.
notifications.denied: This browser blocks notifications for this page. Allow them in the browser's settings for this site, then try again.

signIn.title: Sign in to use Kettu
signIn.intro: Sign in with the Kettu account your computer is signed in to, and reach it from any network.
signIn.pairing: After you sign in, adding this browser goes on.
signIn.own: On the computer’s own network you can also open the browser link from Add device, without an account.

reasons.account-page: This browser was signed out from your account page.
reasons.admin: Kettu’s support team ended this browser’s sign-in.
reasons.disabled: Your Kettu account is disabled. Contact hello@kettu.sh for help.
reasons.reused: A sign-in token was used twice, so this browser was signed out to protect your account.
reasons.expired: The sign-in expired. Sign in again to go on.
reasons.invalid: The sign-in is no longer valid, for example because the account was deleted.

failures.network: Kettu couldn’t reach the account service. Check your connection, then try again.
failures.service: The account service couldn’t finish the sign-in. Try again.
failures.disabled: This Kettu account is disabled. Contact hello@kettu.sh for help.
failures.device-limit: This account’s devices are full. Sign one out, then sign in again.
failures.timeout: The sign-in wasn’t finished. Try again.
failures.local: The sign-in didn’t finish. Try again.

problem.host_offline: {{name}} is not on the Kettu relay now: it may be off or asleep, Kettu may not be running, or it is signed out or not using the relay.
problem.wrong_account: {{name}} is signed in to another Kettu account than this browser.
problem.unreachable: Kettu can’t reach its relay. Check this device’s connection.
